job.name: s10_hurry
job.prompt: Semi-flat illustration. A customer in a coat with a bag on the shoulder leans over the pharmacy counter in a hurry, glancing at a wristwatch, impatient; the pharmacist from the photo reference (same face, hair, white coat) behind the counter stays calm and friendly, about to ask a short question. Walls and shelves have NO signs, posters, labels or text at all.
job.meaning: человек спешит: «просто дайте что-нибудь, только быстро»
